title: JANUS A18.40 Challenge Result and A18.41 Dynamic Target Morphing Design

summary.short: A18.40 rejected a reproducible SHA-256 quality advantage for post-target drain tails while strongly confirming a controllable worker-cohort wave. A18.41 moves from observation to dynamic boundary morphing and wave-memory testing.
summary.long: This entry seals the independent 100-block A18.40 challenge and defines the next A18.41 stage. The cryptographic-quality hypothesis did not replicate: exposure-matched real tails and pseudo tails were statistically indistinguishable. The engineering wave remained strongly reproducible: target 3 generated variable drain tails while target 16 absorbed the complete observed logical cohort. A18.41 introduces a delayed-read Look-Away Observer finalization protocol, separate batch-sequence and completion-ordinal controls, dynamic target changes during execution, and explicit previous-wave-state experiments.

confidence.a18_40_hash_quality_negative: high for the tested target-3 restarted-wave design
confidence.finite_logical_worker_cohort: high in the tested runtime configuration

claim_limits: A18.40 does not prove that all possible wave configurations lack a hash-quality effect.
The observed 16 logical worker slots are not claimed to be 16 physical cores.
Post-target work is not automatically useless to the pool.
No energy, temperature, or hardware-lifetime improvement has yet been demonstrated.
The Look-Away Observer is an engineering delayed-read protocol, not a quantum-mechanical claim about SHA-256.
A18.41 still restarts the process and pool connection between waves; persistent Wave Rider remains future work.

a18_40_challenge.technical_interpretation: The seven excluded target-3 runs exposed an observer-finalization race: exact exposure could be emitted before the full per-batch cryptographic observer record was durably finalized.

target_16.interpretation: The complete observed logical cohort was absorbed by the target-16 boundary in every valid run.

primary_hash_quality_test.endpoint: per-block mean best_hash_score_bits real tail minus exposure-matched pseudo tail
primary_hash_quality_test.interpretation: The weak positive calibration direction did not replicate in the independent frozen challenge.

rare_event_comparison.interpretation: No meaningful rare-event separation was observed at equal exposure.

control_label_correction.problem: The prior report label described completion-ordinal matching while the implemented selector corresponded to logical batch_sequence positions.
control_label_correction.required_fix: Report PSEUDO_BATCH_SEQUENCE_CONTROL and PSEUDO_COMPLETION_ORDINAL_CONTROL separately and never relabel one as the other.

wave_memory_hint.claim_limit: This does not establish memory in SHA-256 or persistent in-process memory.

a18_41_design.title: Dynamic Target Morphing, Look-Away Observer Finalization, and Wave Memory
a18_41_design.internal_target_definition: An experimental completed-batch boundary; not pool difficulty and not an alteration of SHA-256.

look_away_observer.name: LOOK_AWAY_OBSERVER_FINALIZATION_BARRIER
look_away_observer.metaphor: The observer deliberately looks away while the wave develops and turns back only after execution closes.
look_away_observer.live_phase: The supervisor reads only the cardinality of durable finalized-envelope files. It does not inspect best hash, nonce, maximum_z, or tail buckets while selecting the target-change moment.
look_away_observer.prepared_precommit: Before exact exposure is published, the hook atomically writes a full per-batch PREPARED envelope containing batch identity, exact exposure, full best digest, best nonce, nonce range, worker/round/path coordinates, maximum_z, tail buckets, and timestamps.
look_away_observer.finalized_commit: After the native outcome is appended, the hook atomically writes a FINALIZED envelope.
look_away_observer.turn_around_phase: Only after the child process exits does the supervisor open the observer records and run the finalization barrier.
look_away_observer.recovery_rule: A missing native outcome may be recovered only from a durable envelope with the identical batch_id and exact delta_hashes. No guessed or inferred cryptographic field is permitted.
look_away_observer.scientific_limit: The protocol prevents live hash-quality steering and reduces metadata-finalization races. It does not imply that observation changes SHA-256. The hook still adds equal observer I/O to every arm.

corrected_controls.PSEUDO_BATCH_SEQUENCE_CONTROL: Target-16 batches selected after sorting by logical batch_sequence.
corrected_controls.PSEUDO_COMPLETION_ORDINAL_CONTROL: Target-16 batches selected after sorting by actual completion_ordinal.
corrected_controls.mandatory_rule: Both controls must be emitted separately with explicit selector provenance.

current_implementation_limits: ADMISSION_CLOSE_NOW is implemented with external CTRL_BREAK as an admission-close proxy.
Each wave still uses a separate process and reconnects to the pool.
dispatch timestamp is currently a proxy until native admission instrumentation exists.
No clean joule or temperature sensor telemetry is included.
Full live Windows and pool-connected behavior must be established by operator calibration.
operator_sequence: Review REPORT_FOR_CHATGPT.json and SUITE_STATE.json before any challenge.
Only after calibration review, consider START_CHALLENGE_4_MATRICES.cmd for 200 runs.
Use RESUME_LAST_A18_41.cmd only for a genuinely interrupted suite.
